# Wonek — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> End-to-end encrypted P2P communication and collaboration workspace built on QUIC/WebTransport and Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) with high-rate direct peer-to-peer connectivity across mobile CGNAT and encrypted relay fallback.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/wonek-chat-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/wonek-chat-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS (Pre-Release)
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) forward-secret and post-compromise-secure end-to-end encryption for 1:1 and group sessions.
- QUIC/WebTransport multi-stream transport supporting low-latency HD audio/video calls, live screen sharing, Push-to-Talk (PTT), and resumable direct P2P file transfers.
- High-rate direct P2P NAT traversal across mobile Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT) paired with automatic E2EE relay fallback under strict UDP-blocking firewalls.
- Real-time collaborative CRDT documents, shared multi-view calendars, and isolated Personal/Work profiles.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://wonek.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://wonek.com/security/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://wonek.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://wonek.com/guides/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://wonek.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
